title: Desktop quit confirmation and relaunch
description: Requires macOS Accessibility permission, a built Dev app and FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE for an existing gateway. Uses an isolated profile and ports 9543/9544. Set FARMSLOT_DESKTOP_APP to repeat with the production bundle. No inference or dispatch.

quit-and-relaunch.intent: Desktop quit requires confirmation and preserves the gateway and saved login.
